title: VIABILITY PROBE: what an off-screen vessel hull costs to keep skinning (Angler.fbx, 8 behind the camera)
runtimeWriters: AnglerAnimation.Initialize sets SkinnedMeshRenderer.updateWhenOffscreen = true (AnglerAnimation.cs:82); 14 more vessel animation scripts do the same (grep 'updateWhenOffscreen = true'). Nothing sets localBounds.
exposure: Every rigged hull in every match; about half the seats are off screen at any moment.
note: Probe only: the bounds here are not proven to hold every pose. It answers whether the saving is worth the per-vessel bound proof.
